title: Busy Bee Hive
premise: Bees keep flying in and out of the hive. Help the queen know how many are home.
idea: Once the hive door shuts the bees inside cannot be counted one by one, so the child has to start from the number on the sign and count on or back for the bees that move. The honey cups they set out are the answer.
author: claude-stand-in, written through the generation pipeline
